question: Which Indian economist was awarded the Padma Vibhushan in 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bibek Debroy**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Bibek Debroy** was posthumously awarded the **Padma Vibhushan**, India's second-highest civilian honor, in **January 2025**.
 
• He was a distinguished **Indian economist**, scholar, and author who significantly influenced India's economic policy and academic landscape.
 
• He served as the **Chairman** of the **Economic Advisory Council to the Prime Minister (EAC-PM)** until his passing in **late 2024**.
 
• The award was conferred in the field of **Literature and Education**, reflecting his vast contributions to scholarship beyond just **Economics**. ***Hence, the correct answer is Bibek Debroy.***
 
• He was also a former **Member** of **NITI Aayog**, where he played a crucial role in shaping developmental strategies for the **Government of India**.
